purpose: Verify portable camera policy, precision retention, and opt-in trace tests for the tween candidate
command: timeout 600s bash -c 'set -e; for test in policy_test precision_policy_test precision_trace_test; do g++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I modules/camera/include modules/camera/tests/$test.cpp -o /tmp/skycrpg-dyl158-tween-$test; /tmp/skycrpg-dyl158-tween-$test; done'
cleanup: process exits naturally or timeout terminates it; temporary binaries and log retained in /tmp
